Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); fund balance roll-forward 1,938,437 + 1,007,786 - 1,214,481 + 58,417 (sale of assets) = 1,790,159. Beginning cash not printed (null); ending cash 1,779,097 from the governmental funds statement of assets (p3). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets and fund balances (p3, totals equal the government-wide governmental column 1,790,159), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p6): 899,856 + 357,956 - 291,603 = 966,209; total expenses 291,603 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2). Detail is per fund column of the governmental funds and proprietary funds statements; the only supplementary schedule (p9, Budget and Actual - All Funds, combined governmental + utility figures on a different basis) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Capital Outlay 528,451 has no printed function (General Fund column). Read pages 1-9 of 9
